note: Pass thresholds. They come from the verification plan. v2 adds the headroom gate for generator v4. Committed before any v4 run. Do not change after a run to make a result pass. v3 adds the litm block (lost in the middle, phrasing, auto-recall), committed before any run of probe design 2. v4 adds H1n, H6, H7 and the design-3 settings, committed before any run of probe design 3.

primary_comparisons.name: B minus A at N=10, all types
B minus A at N=30, all types
B minus A at N=10, type X

headroom_rule: discriminative at N = (oracle accuracy minus arm A accuracy at N, scored types) >= headroom_min_points. If not, the gain verdict at that N is 'BENCHMARK TOO EASY at this N: no claim either way'.
zero_parse_gate: arm Z parse rate is INFO only; a Z parse failure counts as wrong

litm.note: Pre-registered before any data. A hypothesis that fails stays in the report. Do not change after a run.
litm.h1_note: H1 prints 'TOO EASY: no claim' if the mean of the start and end accuracy of arm A (no compaction, cued) is above h1_ceiling_max_accuracy. H1 uses the mean of the start rate and the end rate, not pooled items.
litm.h2_label: expected, not blind; mixes compaction with session length

nc_validity.note: A no-compaction session is valid only if the last-turn context (input + cache read tokens) is at least this share of nc_estimate_tokens, the transcript has no cleared-tool-result marker, and it has no compaction.

litm.h1n_note: H1n: the H1 rule on non-literal probes (arm A, no compaction), same thresholds and same ceiling.
litm.h6_note: K minus B search rate (used_lookup) on neutral probes, no compaction: point above 0 and CI lower bound above 0. Stop rule: if the pilot shows no higher search rate for K, stop and remove the levers.

design3.filler: pasted documents in user turns, one small task each (not graded)
